topic: Reviewing data discrepancies and next steps
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on analyzing significant data discrepancies observed in Brazil. Initial efforts involved multiple team members, including Galina who developed a plan and someone else (Vlad) who is implementing it.

[p1] expressed concern over the magnitude of the changes, noting that the data should only vary by 10-20% but showed unpredictable jumps. Potential variables influencing the data were discussed, such as recalculations performed on staging environments.

Later, [p1] requested a brief call with [me], which was agreed upon for the Dev environment.
decisions: A meeting time and location (Dev) was set up to discuss the data discrepancies.
